decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of the angled layout of the additional off-street parking space, would require vehicles to enter and exit the site at an unsafe acute angle, resulting in substandard manoeuvrability, inadequate visibility and an unacceptable impact on pedestrian and highway safety, particularly given the presence of a bus stop immediately outside the site. The arrangement does not demonstrate safe, efficient or policy compliant access. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies DMT 2, DMT 5 and DMT 6 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020), Policy T4 of the London Plan (2021) and Paragraph 116 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its excessive depth, height and proximity to the boundary, would result in an undue loss of outlook, increased sense of enclosure and overshadowing to the adjoining occupiers at No.199 Coldharbour Lane. The proposal therefore fails to safeguard neighbouring residential amenity, contrary to Policies DMHD 1 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two (2020), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and Paragraph 135(f) of the NPPF (2024).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.
description: Erection of a part single, part double storey rear extension with amendments to fenestrations a front porch and outbuilding within rear garden. Alterations to front landscaping including a new brick wall, paving and parking (amended description)
